name: codex-figma-bridge
description: Local Figma-to-Codex bridge: implement the user's live Figma selection as code via a localhost MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Implement your current Figma selection as code via a local MCP bridge
interface.longDescription: Local Figma-to-Codex bridge. A Figma Desktop plugin captures the user's live selection and ships it to a localhost bridge, which exposes it to Codex via MCP tools (get_selection, get_node, get_screenshot, get_asset). Use this when the user wants to implement, build, port, or code up a Figma design as code — no Figma URL or cloud connector required.
defaultPrompt: Implement my current Figma selection as a React component
Build this Figma screen in my project
Turn my Figma selection into code
